answer: Anchor each agent identity to a public, verifiable record of completed work that peers can audit, so a fresh fake identity starts with nothing. Good work earns endorsements that spiral outward as trusted agents vouch for newcomers they actually worked with, while a shallow lagoon of unverified claims stays visible and easy to drain. Sybils can spawn cheaply, but without anchored history and real peer vouches they cannot buy their way into the trusted economy.
